digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Implement skill documentation must define a surface-parity census enumerating five parallel surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason disposition for each.
Test design must require one test per config key proving the key changes behavior through the real read path (default vs non-default contrast), addressing config-read-but-miswired escapes.

Contention trigger cases must be routed by shape (composed/check-then-act writes, write-storm/retry/reclamation, read-integrity-under-contention) to existing shared suites without creating bespoke harnesses.
Behavioral gate findings must have a RED test added first in the same change before the fix is applied, while non-behavioral findings (naming/docs/style) are fixed directly.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep must enumerate all out-of-scope census slots and compromises with filed/accepted/fixed outcomes and reasons for each.
